summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 30, 2026. All resolutions, including the re-election of board members, were approved, maintaining the current board composition. The filing references a prior convening notice furnished on June 17, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change; it is purely a standard corporate governance update with no financial terms or deal mechanics.
